## What and why / Hva og hvorfor

## How I checked it / Hvordan jeg sjekket

- [ ] The test suite is green (in the public repository the maintainer runs it)
- [ ] Checked in a browser, and axe (WCAG 2.2 AA) clean on what changed
- [ ] Light and dark, and the accents the change touches
- [ ] Keyboard and screen reader for anything interactive
- [ ] Docs in both languages and `CHANGELOG.md` (`## Unreleased`) updated

## Breaking? / Bryter det noe?

No, or: what apps must change, and the deprecation.
